answer: Paired-receipt bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files two receipts — a lantern-signed receipt and a velvet-sealed twin on the zephyr relay that epoch. An auditor matches the pair by serial; a lone receipt, reused serial, or mismatched pair burns the bond. Each fake needs a fresh pair, 45 each, so 1,000 fakes pay 90,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented twin fails: same key required; an honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its share.
